# kubeworkspaces

```go
import "github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/api"
```

Package kubeworkspaces implements the kube\-workspaces REST API service layer. It provides HTTP endpoints for managing workspaces, volumes, images, and namespaces within a Kubernetes cluster. The API is designed using the Goa framework and supports both authenticated and unauthenticated operation modes.

# auth

```go
import "github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/api/internal/auth"
```

Package auth provides authentication and authorization middleware for the kube\-workspaces API. It implements OIDC\-based login flows, JWT session management, role\-based access control \(admin/editor/viewer\), and integrates with the AuthConfig and User CRDs for configuration. When auth is disabled, all requests are treated as admin\-level access.

Package auth provides authentication and authorization middleware for the kube\-workspaces API. When auth is disabled \(AuthConfig.spec.enabled=false\), all middleware passes through transparently.

# k8s

```go
import "github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/api/internal/k8s"
```

Package k8s provides Kubernetes client wrappers for the kube\-workspaces API server. It includes specialized clients for workspaces, images, CRDs, core resources \(pods, services, PVCs\), and a metrics buffer for caching pod resource usage data.

# proxy

```go
import "github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/api/internal/proxy"
```

Package proxy implements HTTP reverse proxying to workspace pods. It handles routing requests to specific workspace containers, supporting both standard HTTP requests and WebSocket upgrades for terminal access and other real\-time communication.

Package proxy provides a reverse proxy for workspace services running in\-cluster. It supports HTTP and WebSocket connections, with Location header rewriting for redirects. Proxy behavior is configurable per\-image via ProxyConfig.

<a name="Handler"></a>
## func [Handler](<https://github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/blob/main/api/internal/proxy/proxy.go#L61>)

```go
func Handler(opts *HandlerOptions) http.Handler
```

Handler returns an http.Handler that proxies requests to workspace services. URL pattern: /proxy/\{namespace\}/\{name\}/\{rest...\} Proxies to: http://{name}.{namespace}.svc.cluster.local:80/{rest...}

Supports WebSocket upgrade transparently via httputil.ReverseProxy. Applies per\-image proxy configuration when available.

ShouldServeNoOpSW checks if any image in the registry needs a no\-op ServiceWorker. Used to decide whether to serve /sw.js at the root level.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/blob/main/api/internal/proxy/proxy.go#L19-L33>)

Config holds proxy behavior hints for a specific workspace image.

```go
type Config struct {
    // NeedsNoOpSW: serve a no-op ServiceWorker at /sw.js to prevent SW registration errors.
    NeedsNoOpSW bool
    // WebSocketPaths: paths that use WebSocket (informational — all paths support WS transparently).
    WebSocketPaths []string
    // RewriteHostAbsolutePaths: rewrite requests with absolute paths that escape the proxy
    // prefix by using the Referer header to determine the target workspace.
    RewriteHostAbsolutePaths bool
    // CustomRequestHeaders: additional headers to inject into proxied requests.
    CustomRequestHeaders map[string]string
    // InjectBaseTag: inject a <base> tag into HTML responses (not yet implemented).
    InjectBaseTag bool
    // TLSInsecure: connect to backend over HTTPS with skip-verify (for self-signed certs).
    TLSInsecure bool
}
```

# exec

```go
import "github.com/flaccid/kube-workspaces/api/internal/exec"
```

Package exec provides WebSocket\-based remote command execution in workspace pods. It bridges WebSocket connections from clients to Kubernetes exec streams, enabling interactive terminal sessions within running workspace containers.

Package exec provides a WebSocket\-to\-Kubernetes\-exec bridge for terminal sessions.

```go

```

Handler creates an HTTP handler that upgrades to WebSocket and bridges to pod exec. The handler expects path parameters: namespace, name \(workspace name\). Query parameters: shell \(optional, auto\-detected if not provided\), cols, rows.
